_readme: S703 (worker glendale; d-glendale-own-pages-filed-as-gaps-s703). Glendale's 11 programs with no record file (f-glendale-28-left-s697), each filed with the page and control number that free page read 45016708970 found (customFields.eL_programControlNumber in each tab's own Coursedog data) and one of four reasons. The state's lists come from coci_program_courses, read by the conductor 2026-11-22; every noncredit course there is at 0 units. No model call, no Supabase write: no row exists for these programs, and the capture holds no text for them, so a read with only= naming them refuses (only_refused). The follow-up lever: a tab whose own data names a listed program is that program's candidate (_ranked/candidates), which the extraction's coverage bar would still stop. Customer Service 38973 is filed as page_challenged: Glendale's STV-for-OBT alias binds its own tab NCCS at coverage 1.0 (pricing run 45017885023), and the fresh read 45030485543 met the host's bot check on NCCS. The gap stands in place of a reread (Sam's cost rules: gaps noted instead of rereads).

reasons.own_page_coverage_low: Own page found by its program data; the page prints few of the state's listed courses, so the coarse net refused it.
reasons.no_own_page: No page in the catalog is the program's own; the nearest page's data names a sibling.
reasons.page_challenged: Own page found and bound by its program data, but on the read the host answered that page with its bot check ("Let's confirm you are human", HTTP 405), so the capture holds no text for it. The read is never routed around the challenge.
reasons.wrong_tab_hold: A page held by, or near-missed for, a program its data does not name.
